messages.text:
hiya - this landed from Mats at 16:22:
> Hi Marisol, thank you again for yesterday. I've now spoken with my manager, and my current employer needs me through end of April for the notice period - could we push my start date to Monday 10 May? I'm sorry to raise this after accepting. - Mats
Problem: REQ-2207 funding requires a start by 30 April. I'm reopening the offer on our side and will find out whether the start date can move past 30 April. Don't celebrate yet 😬

so for now he's back to candidate status in TarrowRecruit - he accepted the offer yesterday, but until we land a date the requisition can fund, nothing's settled. the 29 March start is off and there's no start date on file
if the funding rule won't bend and he can't come earlier, this one could slip away from us. hoping not!
